evidence.description: Source of the approved November 9–30 combined timetable; public manifest verified against its release index on 2026-11-20 UTC.

drift.normalization: sorted CSV rows/columns; numeric stop_sequence; padded GTFS hour field; all other cells exact

journeys.basis: Source-calendar daily multisets of ordered stop/platform IDs, boarding/alighting rules, direction, all arrival/departure times, timepoints, headsigns and trip-level wheelchair_accessible/bikes_allowed fields; trip/service/block IDs ignored. Stop-level accessibility changes appear in table drift. Identically named routes within the same agency/type form a line. No fuzzy trip pairing or canonical mapping reuse.
